responsibility: Provides the ISO C type-generic math interface by defining the <tgmath.h> function-like macros in terms of GCC’s __builtin_tgmath selector over the real and complex variants from <math.h> and <complex.h>. It owns the macro-level dispatch layer that chooses the correct float, double, long double, or complex library entry point based on argument types for standard mathematical operations, rather than implementing the math functions themselves.
